profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I love how creating software can solve hard problems and create amazing things. I get excited about breaking down the impossible and the unmanageable to the achievable, and making that happen. Being a software engineer for me is making dreams into reality, both my own and bigger ones. Learning new technologies opens the door to solving harder problems and creating more amazing things, and most of all we do that together. I strive to constantly be both a student and a teacher, in software engineering and everything else in life.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building the future of big data privacy for billions of people around the world in the Ads Events Infra organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Empowering customers through engineering the Microsoft Services Hub, where Microsoft customers come to get premium support, optimize the performance of their Azure services, and get advanced training in Azure technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enabling HoloLens customer pilots built in Unity/Direct3D connected to Mixed Reality services including Azure Spatial Anchors, Azure Remote Rendering, supported with other Azure services such as Functions, Storage, etc.
- Provided premium support to large enterprise customers deploying HoloLens solutions in commercial environments using MDM (Intune, MobileIron, etc.), Azure Active Directory, Windows Store for Business, Microsoft Graph, and other enterprise connecting services.
- Developed proof-of-concepts for breakthrough uses of NUI technologies, such as using Windows Hello for physical access control. IoT, SQL, UWP, WPF, Group Policy, Security/Encryption.

positions.title: Senior SDET
positions.description:
- Built a cross-platform, multi-device test authoring and execution framework leveraging Azure to drive tests that orchestrated multiple cloud-connected clients. Azure Store, Service Bus, SQL, WCF.
- Architected and developed service monitoring and alerting solutions for Windows Phone integration with Windows Live, Xbox Live, and Zune leveraging WCF, SQL, ASP.NET, REST APIs.
- Planned and built component automation for various Windows Phone features including Shell controls, marketplace, Cortana.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Programmed games for the Nintendo DS (C), as well as tools and technology development (C/C#).

positions.title: Game Programming Education
positions.description: Taught, assisted in, and developed curriculum for game programming education, including classes at DigiPen as well as offsite, remote, and asynchronous education.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Hunt the Wumpus @ Redmond High School
volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored high school students in AP Computer Science as they built a game project on a small team.

company.name: Hunt the Wumpus @ Redmond High School
